selection_notes: RocketMQ 5.5.1 is published as a Java release but its official Docker tag was absent during selection; select the verified stable 5.5.0 server/client pair before qualification.
MySQL 8.4.10 LTS is project-local; the existing Windows MySQL 8.0.44 service is unrelated.

TypeScript 7.0.2 failed the first M2 production typecheck because the then-current vue-tsc integration used an unexported compiler subpath; M2 locks TypeScript 6.0.3 and vue-tsc 3.3.13 after repeating the same build gate.
No image, library or interface qualification follows merely from this lock. Actual startup and probes remain mandatory.
